info.brief: Plays an MPEG1 or AV1 video on a GUI box node, optionally with its sound.
info.description:
Plays an MPEG1 or AV1 video on a GUI box node, optionally with its sound.
It is built on the `mpeg` native extension. Call `init` from the GUI script's
`init`, `update` from its `update` and `final` from its `final`, passing the
script's `self`: the module keeps each player on it. Map
`/mpeg/video_yuv.material` in the GUI scene as `video_yuv` to convert frames on the
GPU instead of the CPU.

elements.name: init
elements.brief: Start a video player on `self`, replacing the one in the same `field`.
elements.description:
Start a video player on `self`, replacing the one in the same `field`.
It shows the first frame at once and, with `sound`, decodes the whole audio track
and starts it. Throws when the video, its material or its node cannot be used.

parameters.name: self
parameters.doc: The GUI script's `self`, which holds the player.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: The node, the video and how to play it.

elements.name: update
elements.description:
Advance one video player.
It moves by `dt` scaled by its playback speed or, while its sound plays, to the
sound's position. A non-looping video that ends with `stop_on_last_frame` keeps its
last frame and is finished.

parameters.name: dt
parameters.doc: The game frame's time step, in seconds.

parameters.name: field
parameters.doc: The player's `field`. Defaults to the single-video field.

elements.name: final
elements.brief: Stop one video player and release what it holds.
elements.description:
Stop one video player and release what it holds.
It stops the sound, closes the decoder and releases the runtime texture and atlas.
Call it from `final`, or reopening the GUI leaks them.

parameters.name: field
parameters.doc: The player's `field`. Defaults to the single-video field.

elements.name: is_finished
elements.brief: Whether one video has stopped on its last frame.
elements.description:
Whether one video has stopped on its last frame.
A looping video, one with `stop_on_last_frame` off, or a `field` with no player
never has.

parameters.name: field
parameters.doc: The player's `field`. Defaults to the single-video field.

elements.name: init_many
elements.brief: Start several video players at once.
elements.description:
Start several video players at once.
When one fails, those already started are finalized before the error is rethrown.

parameters.name: options_list
parameters.doc: One options table per video, each with its own `field`.

elements.name: update_all
elements.brief: Advance the given video players, or every one `self` holds.
elements.description: Advance the given video players, or every one `self` holds.

parameters.name: dt
parameters.doc: The game frame's time step, in seconds.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.doc: The players' fields. Defaults to every player, in start order.

elements.name: final_all
elements.brief: Finalize the given video players, or every one `self` holds, in reverse order.
elements.description: Finalize the given video players, or every one `self` holds, in reverse order.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.doc: The players' fields. Defaults to every player.

elements.name: are_finished
elements.brief: Whether every given video has stopped on its last frame, or every one `self` holds.
elements.description:
Whether every given video has stopped on its last frame, or every one `self` holds.
`false` when there is none.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.doc: The players' fields. Defaults to every player.

properties.name: video_resource
properties.brief: Path of the video in `custom_resources`.
properties.description: Path of the video in `custom_resources`.

properties.name: video_data
properties.brief: The video's data; when given, it is played instead of loading `video_resource`.
properties.description: The video's data; when given, it is played instead of loading `video_resource`.

properties.name: node
properties.brief: Id of the box node that shows the video.
properties.description: Id of the box node that shows the video.

properties.name: field
properties.brief: Field on `self` that holds this player, for a GUI with several videos.
properties.description:
Field on `self` that holds this player, for a GUI with several videos.
Defaults to one shared field, so a single video needs none.

properties.name: gui_url
properties.brief: URL of the GUI component the runtime atlas is added to. Defaults to `msg.url()`.
properties.description: URL of the GUI component the runtime atlas is added to. Defaults to `msg.url()`.

properties.name: sound
properties.brief: URL of a sound component to play the audio track through. Without it the video plays silently.
properties.description: URL of a sound component to play the audio track through. Without it the video plays silently.

properties.name: audio_resource
properties.brief: A separate MPEG audio file to play instead of the video's own track.
properties.description:
A separate MPEG audio file to play instead of the video's own track.
It is a `custom_resources` path. An AV1 video needs it for sound.

properties.name: audio_data
properties.brief: A separate MPEG audio file's data, used instead of `audio_resource`.
properties.description: A separate MPEG audio file's data, used instead of `audio_resource`.

properties.name: sound_resource
properties.brief: The sound resource the `sound` component plays.
properties.description:
The sound resource the `sound` component plays.
Its data is replaced with the decoded track. Defaults to
`/mpeg/video_sound.wavc`; two videos with sound at once each need their own copy.

properties.name: gain
properties.brief: Gain of the sound. Defaults to `1`.
properties.description: Gain of the sound. Defaults to `1`.

properties.name: yuv
properties.brief: Whether frames are converted to RGB by the YUV material.
properties.description:
Whether frames are converted to RGB by the YUV material.
`true` requires the material and throws when it is not mapped; `false` always
converts on the CPU. Defaults to using the material when it is mapped.

properties.name: yuv_material
properties.brief: Name of the YUV material in the GUI scene. Defaults to `video_yuv`.
properties.description: Name of the YUV material in the GUI scene. Defaults to `video_yuv`.

properties.name: loop
properties.brief: Loop the video and its sound. Defaults to `true`.
properties.description: Loop the video and its sound. Defaults to `true`.

properties.name: stop_on_last_frame
properties.brief: Stop a non-looping video on its last frame. Defaults to `true`.
properties.description: Stop a non-looping video on its last frame. Defaults to `true`.

properties.name: blend_frames
properties.brief: Crossfade between neighbouring frames, using a clone of the node. Defaults to `false`.
properties.description: Crossfade between neighbouring frames, using a clone of the node. Defaults to `false`.

properties.name: playback_speed
properties.brief: Speed multiplier, applied to the sound as well. Defaults to `1`.
properties.description: Speed multiplier, applied to the sound as well. Defaults to `1`.

properties.name: playback_fps
properties.brief: Playback frame rate; when set, it overrides `playback_speed`.
properties.description: Playback frame rate; when set, it overrides `playback_speed`.

properties.name: fallback_fps
properties.brief: Frame rate to use when the file stores none. Defaults to `24`.
properties.description: Frame rate to use when the file stores none. Defaults to `24`.

properties.name: max_frames_per_update
properties.brief: Most video frames decoded in one game frame. Defaults to `2`.
properties.description: Most video frames decoded in one game frame. Defaults to `2`.

properties.name: max_lag
properties.brief: With sound, how far in seconds the picture may fall behind it.
properties.description:
With sound, how far in seconds the picture may fall behind it.
Past that it jumps to the nearest key frame. Defaults to `0.3`.

properties.name: enable_node
properties.brief: Enable the node once the video is ready. Defaults to `true`.
properties.description: Enable the node once the video is ready. Defaults to `true`.

properties.name: runtime_name
properties.brief: Base name of the runtime texture and atlas paths. Defaults to `gui_video`.
properties.description: Base name of the runtime texture and atlas paths. Defaults to `gui_video`.

properties.name: texture_key
properties.brief: Key the runtime atlas is added to the GUI under. Defaults to `video`.
properties.description: Key the runtime atlas is added to the GUI under. Defaults to `video`.

properties.name: animation_id
properties.brief: Id of the runtime atlas animation the node plays. Defaults to `white`.
properties.description: Id of the runtime atlas animation the node plays. Defaults to `white`.

properties.name: video_data
properties.brief: The video's data.
properties.description: The video's data.

properties.name: video_resource
properties.brief: Name of the video in error messages.
properties.description: Name of the video in error messages.
